content.title: Gemini IPO, Boeing's potential $3M fine, American Airlines
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton outlines some of Friday's top market stories as part of Yahoo Finance's Market Minute, including Gemini Space Station's (GEMI) public trading debut, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) threatening a $3 million fine on Boeing (BA), and JPMorgan analysts lifting its price target for American Airlines (AAL) stock.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
